stories.title: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance
stories.description: In its MLPerf benchmarks debut, with results released today, the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform delivers leading performance across training, post-training and agentic inference. NVIDIA swept every MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark and, in its first MLPerf Endpoints submission, delivered more than 10x generational gains in throughput per watt for agentic AI — measuring how much agentic […]
